title: Mubarak for a new beginning for Islam in 1429!
body:
(For the occasion of the beginning of Muharram and the arrival of Sheikh Hisham Effendi)
May Allah forgive us! As-salamu alaikum!
Today just honoured us, last night, Sheikh Hisham Efenid Hazretleri,
Mededu-l Haqq, giving honour to our Dergah. We have been honoured and
also I am happy that as long as he is going to be here, to address to
you, what Allah Almighty giving to him. Before I was... I may speak and
people listening, but it was a heavy burden to speak to people. To be
Imam, to be Khatim, it is not a what you are saying, as a formality, but
really Imam must be something from spirituality to give to people.
Wood to wood, or candle to candle can’t give anything, but if candle is
lightening, there is a fire on it, one may reach to 1.000, even to
1.ooo.ooo or to 1 billion people. One candle is enough to wake up our
candles through our hearts. But now it is so difficult to reach such a
people, because they, all of them, (are) hidden, and you are not asking.
(If) you are not giving your whole energy for asking such a person, it

is difficult to find such a person. So many people, they are knowing so
many things, but yet their candles (are) not awakened. If (they are) not
awakened, (they) can’t wake up, making you to wake up. And that is the
sign of Last Days...
Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim, Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim. We are
beginning to run away to Allah , to run to Allah from Shaitan. Because
Shaitan, anytime (he is) looking an enlightened candle, (he is) coming
and extinguishing that. Therefore we are saying (for him) to be away
from our meetings. Don’t give way to Shaitan! How you are not giving?
!hen you are saying “Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim, Bismillahir
Rahmanir Rahim!” Shaitan (is) running away, but after a while (he is)
coming, coming, not leaving you. Therefore, (the) most important Wird
now (is) to say: Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim. For every purposes
say: Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim, because our egos (are) running
after Shaitan, asking to run after Shaitan. After our egos (are) asking
to dive- where? (Into) sewage channels. Asking. Quickly asking to run in
it, because its pleasure, egos pleasure, is to run into sewage channels.
Therefore, when you are looking and seeing that your ego (is) asking to
run, say: Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim! Beware, or you are finding
yourself through sewage channels! Therefore people they are like rats
(?)...lup lup lup lup lup... “That is modern life that we must reach
like Europeans and Americans, western people! They... look, how their
life (is) high life!” “Where?” “Come with me! Sewage channels! Try it!”
“I can do?” “Yes, free, free! Jump in it!” Lup!... Then saying: “Ya Hu,
come out!” “No, no, here (there is) modernized, life , western life,
high life!” Tauba, Astaghfirullah al ‘Azim!
Therefore, Mu’min, believer, must be awakened person! If not, Shaitan
(is) quickly taking you to fall in sewage channels. Aman, ya Rabbi!

Whole people (are) running, running, running after this...
Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim ... at least 4o x daily you must use
it, to be powerful, (because) that Shaitan (is) rushing on you!

And

then, Subhanallah, Maulana Sheikh, Sultanu-l Awliya, may Allah raise his
rank- was saying: “Now (there is) no way for Murids to reach from one
level (to a) higher station, higher station; (the) only important Wird
(is) to say for every occasion that you are asking to get in, to say:
Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim!” Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim! Bismillahir
Rahmanir Rahim! And also it is not going to be a perfect obedience
without ‘Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim’. If you are not saying ‘Bismillahir
Rahmanir Rahim’, (it is) never getting to be a perfect acceptable
service for the Lord of Heavens.
And also it is) mentioned through (the) Holy Hadith that who is not
saying at the beginning of anything, (of) any action: “Alhamdulillahi
Rabbi-l ‘Alamin”, it is not going to be perfect. Therefore say:
“Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim, Alhamdulillahi Rabbi-l ‘Alamin”, that we
can come here, we can sit and hear and we can be able to force our egos
to follow ourselves! That (is) giving this spiritual power, pumping...
because you may use it once, second, for second action, you must pump
again power and (it is) enough: Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim,
Alhamdulillahi Rabbi-l ‘Alamin’, but (it is) in one that we must say:
“Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim”, then you may say: “Bismillahir
Rahmanir Rahim, Alhamdulillahi Rabbi-l ‘Alamin!” Till a person (is)
saying this, (he) can be able to conquer his ego and defeat Shaitan from
himself! It is not something that you need to read hundreds of books,
no, such a simple things, it is getting, giving power, power! We are
beginning and Allah (is) finishing (it).

If you are beginning with his Holy Name and Huuuu... praising Him, just
dressed, an honour dress you should be granted. How many you can carry?
Uh, that is Nur, that is heavenly Lights that your real being (is) just
honoured and just enlightened. For every action that you are saying:
Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim, Alhamdulillahi Rabbi-l ‘Alamin... just
dressing an honoured dressing that gives you much more glory to carry
you to be in divinely Presence with such a Nur, Lights!
I was thinking that, when Sheikh Hisham Efendi Hazretleri is ready, to
address to you, because every Wali they have another channel. That
Shaitan box, TV, so many channels, and each Wali, each Saint, they have
common channels and also they have special channels for them. Therefore,
if, when he is speaking to you, addressing to you, his channel is
something else. Never going to be on this earth from happenings to be
same two of them, exactly 100 %, no, always changing coming. Therefore,
when they are speaking, one Wali, Saint, speaking, saying and giving a
new news from heavenly Stations. Billion people may be, they may take
billion special channels. Your channels going to be 40, 5o, 6o, 100,
never reaching to 5oo. But channels that Awliya (are) reaching, may be
millons, billions, trillions, quatrillions, pentrillions, may be...
Subhanallah, Subhana-l Mu’ti-l Wahab!
Therefore now I am making an introduction for Sheikh Hisham Effendi, if
I am not speaking, he may speak, but he is not getting happy to speak,
when I am here, but I am nothing. What he is saying, say! His channel is
special, I may hear from him something that I am not hearing from my
channel. Therefore, it is not something (that) belongs to our egos and I
am going to be happy. Such a people Allah Almighty (is) sending from His
selected Awliyas, that (are) carrying from me also... he may speak.
Yesterday I was saying (to) Sheikh Abdu-l Hayy, mazun... I said, til I

am coming, you speak to people. And till I am going from here up to
entrance of our Dergah, they said that: “Sheikh Abdu-l Hayy finishing...
“ “Hah? Yet I am not entering! May speak! Mazun, may speak...!” Welcome
to you, welcome, Sheikh Hisham Hazretleri, I think that he needs a
little bit to rest, because just he arrived after midnight and so many,
perhaps sitting for Salatu-l Fajr, therefore I am... new telescope, I am
looking... I am seeing if not going... I am not using artificial
telescope... (Sheikh is coughing)... We are going to be (like an) old
car... what to do?... Therefore I am leaving today here, it is enough...
Tomorrow he may speak to you from his special channel. Ma sha Allah, he
is going around East and West, so many people, high level people, level
of Presidents, level of crown-princes, level of tyrants... level of
shaitans...bombarding them, therefore... he has a speciality, in such a
way, among Awliya... mashurun, marufun... therefore.... Any news? No...
May Allah forgive us and Mubarak new year! Allah makes it mubarak,
blessed, to be (a) blessed year. I hope to be a new beginning for the
history of Islam, beginning from today, first of Muharram, 1429, to be a
good new beginning, that Islam (is) going to appear, appear, appear...
and Kufr (is) coming down, coming down, and Shaitan’s Sultanate (is)
going to finish and vanish and Islam (is) going to appear, to appear, to
get up to get up... through East and West, from North to South,
everywhere to say:
(Sheikh is making a short Dhikr)
La ilaha ill-Allah, la ilaha ill-Allah, la ilaha-ill-Allah....
... Sayyiduna wa Nabiyuna Muhammadur Rasulullah sws!
Zidhu, ya Rabbi, ‘izzan wa sharafan, wa nuran wa sururan, wa ridwanan wa
sultanan! Zidna bihi, ya Rabbi, kazalik imanan wa yaqinan wa sidqan!

Adrikna, ya Rabbana, ahdu Medhi alayhi salam, ahdu S.Isa alayhi salat wa
salam! Adrikna, ya Rabbi, ayam halli... Anta tatafaddal ibadika salihin,
saadeti-d dunya wa saadeti –l akhira, ya Rabb, bi jahi man arwalta
alayhi Surati-l Fatiha...
Sheikh Hisham Efendi, he is going to be with us insha Allah, 5 or 6 days.
Allah gives him much more power, much more Nur, for the Muslimin also,
for the Baraka of this blessed month, Shahru Muharramu-l Haram, bi jahi
Nabiyi-l Karim, Sayyidi-l Awwalina wa-l Akhirin, Fatiha!...
Mubarak Yaumu-l Jadid!
Lefke, 9.1.2008 Transcribed by Khairiyah Siegel
